title: ASML and TSMC Announce Initiative to Pioneer Industry Transition to Large-Format Photomasks for High NA EUV

passages.note: Opening bullets and sections on TSMC production intentions and pilot line. TSMC intends to start using High-NA in advanced-node high-volume manufacturing in 2030. The companies formed an industry initiative September 7 with separate targets for a 2031 larger-mask pilot line and 2033 system readiness.
